metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented in `output/` as a C++20 CLI tool named `iges` with CMake build support.

Key files:
- [CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt)
- [main.cpp](/workspace/output/src/main.cpp)
- [iges_parser.cpp](/workspace/output/src/iges_parser.cpp)
- [iges_writer.cpp](/workspace/output/src/iges_writer.cpp)
- [iges_eval.cpp](/workspace/output/src/iges_eval.cpp)
- [json.cpp](/workspace/output/src/json.cpp)

What’s implemented:
- Subcommands: `parse`, `write`, `query`, `eval`, `roundtrip`
- Fixed-format IGES section parsing/writing (80-column lines, S/G/D/P/T handling, single-line T output)
- Global section delimiter handling, defaults, spec-version clamping, and required numeric validations
- DE parsing/serialization with status decode/encode and cross-reference checks (`view`, `xform_matrix`, `label_display`)
- Diagnostic envelope generation with section/spec metadata and exit-code behavior
- Entity extraction by DE index (`query`)
- Parametric evaluation (`eval`) for required curve/surface families including transforms (Type 124 chaining)
- Roundtrip writer determinism (smoke-tested fixed-point on repeated roundtrip for sample)

Entity data handling:
- Typed PD decode/encode is implemented for the evaluation-critical geometry set (including 100/102/104/106/108/110/112/114/116/118/120/122/123/124/126/128/130/140/190/192/194/196/198).
- Other catalog entity types are accepted and preserved through parse/write via raw parameter-field fallback for lossless roundtrip.

Build verified:
- `cmake -B build && cmake --build build` ran successfully in `/workspace/output`.

Smoke tests run successfully:
- `write -> parse -> query -> eval -> roundtrip`
- second-pass roundtrip on generated sample was byte-identical.
